properties.name: Pacific Federal Marine Bioregions (Canada)
properties.source: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO), Marine Planning and Conservation Directorate, Federal Marine Bioregions
properties.note: The union of the four bioregions the dataset marks OCEAN_E = Pacific, reprojected from Canada Albers Equal Area Conic (NAD83) to WGS84. This is Canada's own marine-planning framework, not a maritime limit: its seaward edge follows the EEZ, but the dataset describes its boundaries as fuzzy and revisable on ecosystem grounds, so the region is named for the bioregions rather than for the zone. Interior rings (362 islands, Vancouver Island and Haida Gwaii the largest) are dropped: the mask is intersected with `sst_daily`, which holds ocean cells only, so land inside the region is excluded by the data rather than by the geometry -- and a clean outline is what the map wants. Douglas-Peucker simplified at 0.002 deg, which is 1/25 of a grid cell. Longitudes are 0-360, as everywhere else in this project.
